title.zh: 将碧瑶市卢克班小学的名称变更为Gregorio Del Pilar小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Lucban Elementary School in the City of Baguio to Gregorio Del Pilar Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Lucban Elementary School in the City of Baguio to Gregorio Del Pilar Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Lucban tại Thành phố Baguio thành Trường tiểu học Gregorio Del Pilar
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Lucban ในเมือง Baguio เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Gregorio Del Pilar
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Lucban di Kota Baguio menjadi Sekolah Dasar Gregorio Del Pilar
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Lucban di Bandaraya Baguio menjadi Sekolah Rendah Gregorio Del Pilar

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_2019_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Lucban Elementary School in the City of Baguio is hereby changed to Gregorio del Pilar Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1957.
